id: \rGrass types are tough against Water types.
en: \rGrass types are tough against Water types.
it: \rI tipi Erba sono ostici per i tipi Acqua.

id: \rGrass types are weak against Fire types.
en: \rGrass types are weak against Fire types.
it: \rI tipi Erba sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco.

id: \rGardenia: Well who would have thought you would come to challenge me?
en: \rGardenia: Well who would have thought you would come to challenge me?
it: \rGardenia: Ma guarda, chi l'avrebbe mai detto che saresti venuto a sfidarmi?

id: \rWell, actually, first you have to battle my disciples. They are in the other room.
en: \rWell, actually, first you have to battle my disciples.  They are in the other room.
it: \rAnzi, a dire il vero, prima devi lottare con i miei allievi.  Sono nell'altra stanza.

id: \rGardenia: I see you beat them all. I knew you would. After all, when I first saw you, I was convinced you'd find your way to me.
en: \rGardenia: I see you beat them all. I knew you would. After all, when I first saw you, I was convinced you'd find your way to me.
it: \rGardenia: Vedo che li hai battuti tutti. Lo sapevo. Del resto, appena ti ho visto, ero convinta che saresti arrivato fino a me.

id: \rYou have a winning aura about you. Let's have our battle.
en: \rYou have a winning aura about you. Let's have our battle.
it: \rHai un'aura da vincente. Facciamo la nostra lotta.
\rGardenia: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Foresta.

id: \rTM86 contains Grass Knot. The heavier the opponent the more the damage.
en: \rTM86 contains Grass Knot. The heavier the opponent the more the damage.
it: \rLa MT86 contiene Laccioerboso. Più l'avversario è pesante, più danni subisce.

id: \rGardenia: If you ever find a rare Grass type come show me.
en: \rGardenia: If you ever find a rare Grass type come show me.
it: \rGardenia: Se mai trovi un Pokémon di tipo Erba raro, vieni a farmelo vedere.

id: \bGardenia uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
en: \bGardenia uses Grass type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Fire, Poison, Flying, and Ice types.
it: \bGardenia usa Pokémon di tipo Erba. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Fuoco, Veleno, Volante e Ghiaccio.

id: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock. Electric, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Water, Ground, and Rock.  Electric, Grass, Ground, and Water moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Acqua, Terra e Roccia.  Anche le mosse di tipo Elettro, Erba, Terra e Acqua non fanno molti danni.
\rSpero che Gardenia ti faccia a pezzi!
